**Upgrade:** `npm install modern-cmdk@1.7.2` · **Breaking:** none · **Deprecated:** none new

modern-cmdk 1.7.2 makes the Options on the npm page readable on a phone. Nothing changes in how the palette behaves.

### Before you upgrade

- Nothing to do.

### Highlights

- The README lists the options of `createCommandMachine` one per line, so none of them runs off a narrow screen. [Core API](https://abcrimson.github.io/modern-cmdk/api/command.html)
